description: Infer testable EMA/RSI strategy hypotheses from a Hyperliquid wallet's observed decisions and closed market bars. Separates imitation fit from cost-aware holdout backtests. Returns a reusable strategy or insufficient_evidence, never authorizes or executes trading. Use wallet for live reads or history for an archived collection.

bars.description: At most 1000 archived bars within the MCP 128 KiB argument limit. Omit bars for bounded live history, or use CLI/HTTP for larger archives.

name: strategy_infer
